items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: The mention of Frank Stokes occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turns. The [INTERVIEWEE] (Mose Allison Sr.) does not speak in the provided context regarding Frank Stokes.

ctx.x: I see. Well, we've got to get back to Dewey now. Yeah, I think we're about to run out. Unless Dewey wants to tell us some more of his favorite musicians.

Well, I don't know very many of them. I used to play around with a boy called Frank Stokes. The old man he did, that is his son. What's his son? His son named Roosevelt Stokes. Another boy called Earl Bell. See, all those guys. They real young. They younger than we are. See, they didn't know anything. And not to do no good. They liked from under the bus.
What was Frank Stokes like? Did he play good?
